title: Peanut Tagine Chicken with German Twist
description: A hearty German-inspired dish with the flavors of North Africa and the richness of peanuts.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
In a large pan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and the peanuts.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the peanuts are fragrant.
Add the tagine spice mix, chicken broth, and honey to the pan.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the pan and cook until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped peanuts if desired.
Traditionally, a tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid.
If you have access to a tagine, feel free to use it! Otherwise, a Dutch oven or large saucepan will work.
